build_WitKaggleConfig: build a WitKaggleConfig with sample_files, image_folder, split_specific_features, and resnet_embedding_shape
build_WitKaggle: build a WitKaggle GeneratorBasedBuilder with train_with_extended_features and test_without_gold configs
run_WitKaggle__info: run the WitKaggle _info method to return dataset metadata including features, description, and citation
run_WitKaggle__split_generators: run the WitKaggle _split_generators method to extract sample and image archives and return split generators
run_WitKaggle__generate_examples: run the WitKaggle _generate_examples method to process TSV samples, image pixels, and ResNet embeddings via Beam pipeline
